facts.statement: Players join the contest by wearing vampire or werewolf costume pieces when the in-game 'dance contest is about to begin' announcement appears, then go to the marsh location.
facts.quote: Cuando veas un anuncio en el juego que indique “el concurso de baile esta por comenzar” dirígete hasta la Ciénaga de los Huesos.

article_summaries.title: Vampiros vs. Hombres Lobos (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language Free Realms news post for the Spooktacular season describes a Vampires vs. Werewolves dance contest run for the Pumpkin Prince. Players start with Madame Zelda, pick a side, and wear costumes of their side when the in-game announcement appears; the side with the most fans wins a piece of the Pumpkin Prince's special cake. The post gives no exact date; it says 'posted 7 months, 2 weeks ago' relative to the capture date of 2011-06-04.
